additions.proof: וְהַלֵּב הוּא הַצַּיָּר שֶׁל הַמִּדּוֹת, הַיְנוּ הַחָכְמָה שֶׁבַּלֵּב (§א, line 5)
additions.rationale: The Rebbe explicitly equates the heart (לב) with the chokhma-of-the-heart (חכמה שבלב): 'הלב הוא הצייר של המדות, היינו החכמה שבלב'. The phrase 'היינו' is the Rebbe's standard bechina marker — 'meaning' / 'that is to say' = X IS Y. This bechina is stated three times in §א (lines 5, 30, 93) and is the foundational equation of the entire Torah. Neither the node 'לב' nor 'חכמה שבלב' appears in the dataset for ref 49 as bechina nodes, yet their identification is the Torah's most repeated bechina claim.

additions.proof: כְּשֶׁחוֹשֵׁב מַחֲשָׁבוֹת טוֹבוֹת, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת חָכְמָה שֶׁבַּלֵּב (§ד, line 30)
additions.rationale: Line 30 explicitly states: 'when one thinks good thoughts — זֶהוּ בְּחִינַת חָכְמָה שֶׁבַּלֵּב.' The phrase 'זהו בחינת' is direct bechina language. Good thoughts (מחשבות טובות) ARE the chokhma-of-the-heart. This identification is repeated throughout the Torah (lines 6, 21, 30, 31) and is structurally central: it defines what חכמה שבלב IS at the practical level.

additions.proof: מַחֲשָׁבוֹת טוֹבוֹת הֵם יֵצֶר טוֹב (§א, line 6)
additions.rationale: Line 6: 'מחשבות טובות הם יצר טוב.' The word 'הם' (they are) is explicit bechina identification. Good thoughts ARE the yetzer tov. Also repeated in line 37 ('שהם בחינת יצר טוב'). This establishes the cluster: לב = חכמה שבלב = מחשבות טובות = יצר טוב. All are the same reality described from different angles.

additions.proof: וּכְשֶׁמְּצַמְּצֵם אֶת אוֹר לַהֲבִיּוּת לִבּוֹ, אֲזַי נִשְׁאָר חָלָל פָּנוּי בַּלֵּב, בְּחִינַת: וְלִבִּי חָלַל בְּקִרְבִּי, שֶׁזֶּהוּ סוֹד חָלָל הַפָּנוּי (§ד, line 28)
additions.rationale: Torah 49 §ד explicitly states that the heart in its tzimtzum-state IS the chalal panui: 'וְלִבִּי חָלַל בְּקִרְבִּי — שֶׁזֶּהוּ סוֹד חָלָל הַפָּנוּי שֶׁהָיָה בִּתְחִלַּת הַבְּרִיאָה.' The word 'זהו סוד' = 'this IS the secret of' — bechina language. The hollowed/empty heart IS the chalal panui of creation. This equation is the Torah's deepest metaphysical claim and is stated repeatedly (lines 11, 28, 29, 34, 36, 94, 96-98).

additions.proof: וּבְתוֹךְ הֶחָלָל הַפָּנוּי הַזֶּה בָּרָא כָּל הָעוֹלָמוֹת... וְכָל הָעוֹלָמוֹת נִבְרְאוּ עַל־יְדֵי חָכְמָה (§ד, line 23)
additions.rationale: The Torah explicitly identifies the chalal panui as the space where worlds were created. More directly, in lines 28-29 and 33: 'הַמִּדּוֹת הֵן הֵן הָעוֹלָמוֹת' — the midot ARE the worlds — and the midot are revealed in the chalal panui. The relationship between chalal panui and bri'at ha'olamot is one of identity/co-extension: the chalal panui IS the space-of-worlds, and the worlds IS the midot. Line 33 states: 'בְּרִיאַת הָעוֹלָמוֹת, וַעֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם בִּפְעֻלּוֹת וּמִדּוֹת טוֹבוֹת, הֵם בְּחִינָה אַחַת מַמָּשׁ' — they ARE literally one and the same thing.

additions.proof: נִמְצָא, שֶׁהַלֵּב הוּא הַצַּיָּר, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (תהילים עג): צוּר לְבָבִי (§א, line 5). Also lines 93-95: אֵין צַיָּר כֵּאלֹקֵינוּ — הַלֵּב הוּא הַצַּיָּר
additions.rationale: 'צוּר לְבָבִי' (Psalm 73:26) is decoded as 'tzur = tzayar (artist/sculptor)' — so 'צוּר לְבָבִי = the heart is the former/sculptor [of the midot].' This is a classic Rebbe-style bechina: reading a word two ways ('rock' and 'sculptor') to identify the heart's nature. 'צוּר לְבָבִי' appears in the Torah as a recurring technical node (lines 5, 11, 93-95) identifying the heart-as-sculptor. It is a node distinct from 'לב' and 'חכמה שבלב' but equated with the heart's tziyur function.

additions.proof: מַחֲשָׁבוֹת רָעוֹת הֵם יֵצֶר הָרָע (§א, line 6)
additions.rationale: Line 6: 'מחשבות רעות הם יצר הרע.' Direct bechina statement (הם = they are). Evil thoughts ARE the yetzer hara. This is the evil mirror of the מחשבות טובות = יצר טוב equation. Repeated in lines 10, 31, 37.

additions.proof: כִּי הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע הוּא טִפְּשׁוּת הַלֵּב, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (דברים י'): 'וּמַלְתֶּם אֶת עָרְלַת לְבַבְכֶם', וְתַרְגּוּמוֹ: יָת טִפְּשׁוּת לִבְּכוֹן (§א, line 10)
additions.rationale: Line 10: 'הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע הוּא טִפְּשׁוּת הַלֵּב' — explicit bechina (הוא = IS). The yetzer hara IS the stupidity/dullness of the heart. Supported by the Aramaic translation of Deut 10:16: 'ערלת לבב = טפשות לבכון.' This creates the cluster: יצר הרע = מחשבות רעות = טפשות הלב = ערלת לב.

additions.proof: 'וּמַלְתֶּם אֶת עָרְלַת לְבַבְכֶם', וְתַרְגּוּמוֹ: יָת טִפְּשׁוּת לִבְּכוֹן (§א, line 10)
additions.rationale: The Aramaic targum directly equates 'ערלת לבב' with 'טפשות לבכון' — this IS the bechina equation. The Rebbe cites this Targum as the proof that ערלת לב (the foreskin of the heart = closed/blocked heart) IS טפשות (stupidity/dullness). Both are the same concept: the evil-occluded heart.

additions.proof: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת הֵ"א, כִּי דָּלֶ"ת הָיְתָה, וְאִתְחַזְרַת וְנַעֲשֵׂית הֵ"א (§ג, line 15)
additions.rationale: Line 15: 'וְזֶה בְּחִינַת הֵ"א, כִּי דָּלֶ"ת הָיְתָה, וְאִתְחַזְרַת וְנַעֲשֵׂית הֵ"א.' The He IS the rectified Dalet — when the Yud enters the Dalet, it becomes He. 'בחינת' is explicit bechina language. The He letter and the rectified Dalet are identified as the same thing. This connects the existing 'אות דל"ת' node (in Package 3) to the He-letter node, completing the Dalet→He bechina that the Torah teaches in §ג.

additions.proof: כִּי הַצַּדִּיק נִקְרָא שֶׁמֶשׁ, כְּמַאֲמַר חֲכָמֵינוּ: עַד שֶׁלֹּא שָׁקְעָה שִׁמְשׁוֹ שֶׁל עֵלִי... וְזָרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וּבָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ (§ז, line 70)
additions.rationale: Line 70: 'הַצַּדִּיק נִקְרָא שֶׁמֶשׁ' — 'is called שמש' is explicit bechina language (נקרא = is called = is an aspect of). The tzaddik IS the sun in Torah 49's teaching about the tzaddik's revelation via Israel (§ז, lines 69-76). The proof-verse ('זרח השמש ובא השמש') is decoded as succession of tzaddikim. This is a standalone bechina connecting צדיק to שמש.

additions.proof: תּוֹרַת ה' תְּמִימָה — שֶׁהִיא תּוֹרָה דְּעַתִּיקָא, שֶׁהִיא תְּמִימָה עֲדַיִן, שֶׁעֲדַיִן לֹא הִשִּׂיגוּ מִמֶּנָּה כְּלוּם (§ז, line 80)
additions.rationale: Line 80: 'תּוֹרַת ה' תְּמִימָה — שֶׁהִיא תּוֹרָה דְּעַתִּיקָא.' 'שהיא' (which IS) is bechina language. The verse 'תּוֹרַת ה' תְּמִימָה' IS the Torah of Atika — the perfect/unblemished Torah that has not yet been apprehended. This bechina connects the Psalms verse to the Zoharic concept of Oraiyta de-Atika, both of which are in the domain of Package 5 (Shabbat/Teshuva = future revelation). This would add a new node to Package 5.

gap_analysis_notes: The most significant gap in the Torah 49 dataset is the near-complete absence of the Torah's core theoretical domain: the heart (לב) as the creative vessel. The bechina cluster {לב = חכמה שבלב = מחשבות טובות = יצר טוב = צוּר לְבָבִי = חלל הפנוי = בריאת העולמות} is the backbone of the entire Torah — stated explicitly and repeatedly from §א through §ז — yet none of these bechina edges appear in the dataset for reference 49. This cluster constitutes the new package 'torah_49_pkg_new_lev' proposed in torah_49_new_packages.json. The evil mirror cluster {יצר הרע = מחשבות רעות = טפשות הלב = ערלת לב} is equally absent. Additionally, the letter He (אות ה"א) as the bechina of the rectified Dalet is missing from the dataset. The tzaddik=shemesh identification (§ז) and the Torah Temima = Torah de-Atika identification (§ז) are also absent. Total: 12 missing bechina edges spanning 2 major new packages and additions to existing packages.
